Five independent RFC 3320/4077 datagram layouts cover all three partial-state-ID sizes, both returned-feedback forms, a one-byte uploaded-code body and a version-one NACK. Stream record unquoting and NACK error-detail semantics are outside this explicit datagram profile.

Seven independent RFC 3525 Annex B text layouts cover full/compact tokens, transactions and commands, common descriptor structures, replies, pending/ack/error forms and exact comments/CRLF. Six independent historical draft-ipsec-swipe-01 layouts cover plain, clear-sequence, encrypted-header and undefined-control bodies. Pinned Wireshark instead assumes byte lengths, unconditional sequence and IPv6; its decoding is not the oracle for these documented historical vectors.

Sixteen independent IBM GA27-3136-20 field layouts under SC41-5404-08 Ethernet encapsulation include FID0/1/2/3, separate RH request/response fields, sense/IPM, segmented BIU, compression headers and common request codes. One independently serialized aligned-PER GatekeeperRequest with requestSeqNum 1, protocolIdentifier 0.0.8.2250.0.4 and IPv4 127.0.0.1 port 1719. Five independently serialized header layouts based on pinned Wireshark packet-xyplex.c: an eight-byte request, four-byte OK and Queue Full replies, and request/reply variants retaining unknown scalar values and raw tails. Ten independently serialized XTP 4.0 layouts cover DATA with odd/empty body and BTAG, header-only checksum coverage, CNTL, FIRST with variable address/traffic segments, TCNTL, JCNTL and DIAG. Every DLEN and Internet checksum is verified. NOCHECK still verifies the header. First-message address length is not fixed at sixteen bytes. Payload, service/session state and membership meanings remain uninterpreted; ECNTL and obsolete JOIN are explicitly unsupported.

Independent MS-CIFS 2.2.4.52.1 SMB_COM_NEGOTIATE request: WordCount zero, ByteCount 36 and two fully bounded BufferFormat=2 OEM dialect names. The Direct TCP message length is 71 bytes. Independent Oracle RMI transport/serialization grammar control: one complete 57-byte SingleOp Call with a 34-byte primitive block, Object Number zero, Operation minus one, Method Hash 0102030405060708 and string argument sample. Seven independent MS-SMB2 layouts: 3.0, 3.0.2 and context-bearing 3.1.1 requests/responses plus a minimal 3.1.1 request. Complete PREAUTH, encryption, compression, transport, RDMA, signing and request netname contexts have exact counts/lengths and alignment. Each TCP record is independent and direction-specific; no successful negotiation, session, transform decryption or cryptographic verification is implied. The missing-context original remains separate.

Independent MS-WSMV SOAP 1.2 Identify request with namespace-qualified Envelope, Header, Body and Identify, exactly 190 UTF-8 body bytes and 306 HTTP bytes. Ten independent RFC 4559 HTTP records: three RFC 2743/4178 NegTokenInit request structures, six subsequent NegTokenResp structures and one explicitly envelope-only tokenless 401 challenge. Four independent Docker Engine v1.41 ContainerList requests cover the original route, typed all/size/limit, array and boolean-set JSON filters, legacy since/before, repeated query first-value semantics, unknown query preservation and HTTP/IPv6-host variants. Behavior follows pinned Moby v20.10.0 codecs, not an assumed generic boolean parser. No server operation, response, backend acceptance, filter evaluation or endpoint identity is inferred.

Three independent RFC 8555 outer flattened-JWS request structures with protected alg, nonce, url and account kid: an empty POST-as-GET payload, an empty object, and an identifiers object retained without operation-schema validation. Four independent DSP0266 1.23.1 service-root GET records cover explicit OData header presence, excerpt, expand levels, selected property paths, includeoriginofcondition, preserved unknown query occurrences, literal plus URI semantics and length/chunk-framed bodies.
